```{r package loading}
library(tidyverse)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(plyranges)
library(genomation)
library(readr)
library(rtracklayer)
library(stringr)
library(ggrepel)
library(DT)
library(readxl)
```


```{r loading data}
 
DOX_24_ATAC <- readRDS("data/Other_paper_data/Matthews_2025_DOX_24h_ATAC.RDS")

DOX_24_DAR_gr <- DOX_24_ATAC %>% 
  dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val<0.05) %>% 
  dplyr::select(peak) %>% 
  separate(peak, into = c("seqnames","start","stop"),remove = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(start=as.numeric(start),
         stop=as.numeric(stop)) %>% 
  as_granges(seqnames = seqnames,
             start=start,
             end=stop,
             strand="*")
DOX_24_CAR_gr <- DOX_24_ATAC %>% 
  dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val>0.05) %>% 
  dplyr::select(peak) %>% 
  separate(peak, into = c("seqnames","start","stop"),remove = FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(start=as.numeric(start),
         stop=as.numeric(stop)) %>% 
  as_granges(seqnames = seqnames,
             start=start,
             end=stop,
             strand="*")
mcols(DOX_24_CAR_gr)$name <- mcols(DOX_24_CAR_gr)$peak
mcols(DOX_24_DAR_gr)$name <- mcols(DOX_24_DAR_gr)$peak

H3K9me3_summit_gr <- readRDS("data/RDS_files/H3K9me3_complete_summit_gr.RDS")
 H3K9me3_summit_gr_ext <- resize(H3K9me3_summit_gr, width(H3K9me3_summit_gr)+400, fix = "center")

peakAnnoList_H3K9me3 <- readRDS("data/motif_lists/H3K9me3_annotated_peaks.RDS")

H3K9me3_lookup <- imap_dfr(peakAnnoList_H3K9me3[1:3], ~
  tibble(Peakid = .x@anno$Peakid, cluster = .y)
)

H3K9me3_sets_gr <- lapply(peakAnnoList_H3K9me3, function(df) {
  as_granges(df)
})

##assigning Peakid as name of summit region
 mcols(H3K9me3_summit_gr)$name <- mcols(H3K9me3_summit_gr)$Peakid
 
 

```

```{r export DARs and CARs bedlist, eval=FALSE}

library(GenomeInfoDb)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)

export(DOX_24_DAR_gr, "data/Bed_exports/ATAC_DOX_24h_DAR.bed", format = "BED")
export(DOX_24_CAR_gr, "data/Bed_exports/ATAC_DOX_24h_CAR.bed", format = "BED")
genome_sl <- seqlengths(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)

genome_sl <- genome_sl[seqlevels(H3K9me3_summit_gr)]

seqlengths(H3K9me3_summit_gr) <-genome_sl
H3K9me3_summit_gr <- trim(H3K9me3_summit_gr)
H3K9me3_summit_gr_ext <- promoters(
  H3K9me3_summit_gr,
  upstream = 200,
  downstream = 200
)
export(H3K9me3_summit_gr_ext,
  "data/Bed_exports/H3K9me3_summit_gr_ext200.bed",
  format = "bed"
)

```

```{r CAR hits}

CAR_H3K9me3_hits <- findOverlaps(H3K9me3_sets_gr$all_H3K9me3, DOX_24_CAR_gr, ignore.strand = TRUE)
H3K9me3_CAR_overlap <- tibble(
  hit_id = queryHits(CAR_H3K9me3_hits),
  ROI_ID=mcols(H3K9me3_sets_gr$all_H3K9me3)$Peakid[queryHits((CAR_H3K9me3_hits))],
  cluster   = mcols(H3K9me3_sets_gr$all_H3K9me3)$cluster[queryHits(CAR_H3K9me3_hits)],
  CAR_ROI   = mcols(DOX_24_CAR_gr)$peak[subjectHits(CAR_H3K9me3_hits)])

H3K9me3_CAR_peakid <- H3K9me3_CAR_overlap %>% 
  group_by(ROI_ID) %>% 
  distinct(ROI_ID)

CAR_H3K9me3_hits_ext <- findOverlaps(H3K9me3_summit_gr_ext, DOX_24_CAR_gr, ignore.strand = TRUE)
H3K9me3_ext_CAR_overlap <- tibble(
  hit_id = queryHits(CAR_H3K9me3_hits_ext),
  ROI_ID=mcols(H3K9me3_summit_gr_ext)$Peakid[queryHits((CAR_H3K9me3_hits_ext))],
  cluster   = mcols(H3K9me3_summit_gr_ext)$cluster[queryHits(CAR_H3K9me3_hits_ext)],
  CAR_ROI   = mcols(DOX_24_CAR_gr)$peak[subjectHits(CAR_H3K9me3_hits_ext)])

H3K9me3_ext_CAR_peakid <- H3K9me3_ext_CAR_overlap %>% 
  group_by(ROI_ID) %>% 
  distinct(ROI_ID)

```



```{r DAR hits}

DAR_H3K9me3_hits <- findOverlaps(H3K9me3_sets_gr$all_H3K9me3, DOX_24_DAR_gr, ignore.strand = TRUE)
H3K9me3_DAR_overlap <- tibble(
  hit_id = queryHits(DAR_H3K9me3_hits),
  ROI_ID=mcols(H3K9me3_sets_gr$all_H3K9me3)$Peakid[queryHits((DAR_H3K9me3_hits))],
  cluster   = mcols(H3K9me3_sets_gr$all_H3K9me3)$cluster[queryHits(DAR_H3K9me3_hits)],
  DAR_ROI   = mcols(DOX_24_DAR_gr)$peak[subjectHits(DAR_H3K9me3_hits)])

H3K9me3_DAR_peakid <- H3K9me3_DAR_overlap %>% 
  group_by(ROI_ID) %>% 
  distinct(ROI_ID) 


DAR_H3K9me3_hits_ext <- findOverlaps(H3K9me3_summit_gr_ext, DOX_24_DAR_gr, ignore.strand = TRUE)
H3K9me3_ext_DAR_overlap <- tibble(
  hit_id = queryHits(DAR_H3K9me3_hits_ext),
  ROI_ID=mcols(H3K9me3_summit_gr_ext)$Peakid[queryHits((DAR_H3K9me3_hits_ext))],
  cluster   = mcols(H3K9me3_summit_gr_ext)$cluster[queryHits(DAR_H3K9me3_hits_ext)],
  CAR_ROI   = mcols(DOX_24_DAR_gr)$peak[subjectHits(DAR_H3K9me3_hits_ext)])

H3K9me3_ext_DAR_peakid <- H3K9me3_ext_DAR_overlap %>% 
  group_by(ROI_ID) %>% 
  distinct(ROI_ID)


```

```{r}
joint_H3K9me3 <- intersect(H3K9me3_DAR_peakid$ROI_ID, H3K9me3_CAR_peakid$ROI_ID)

prop_ATAC_df <- peakAnnoList_H3K9me3$all_H3K9me3 %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  dplyr::select(Peakid) %>% 
  left_join(H3K9me3_lookup) %>% 
  mutate(cluster = if_else(is.na(cluster), "NA", cluster)) %>% 
  mutate(
    ATAC_type = case_when(Peakid %in% joint_H3K9me3 ~ "joint",
      Peakid %in% H3K9me3_CAR_peakid$ROI_ID ~ "CAR",
      Peakid %in% H3K9me3_DAR_peakid$ROI_ID ~ "DAR",
      TRUE ~ "not_atac"
    )
  ) %>%
  count(cluster, ATAC_type, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  mutate(
    percent = n / sum(n) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(prop_ATAC_df, aes(x = cluster, y = percent, fill = ATAC_type)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", percent)),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(y = "Proportion")+
  theme_bw()+
  ggtitle("Proportion of CARs and DARs in each H3K9me3 set")
  

prop_ATAC_df %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(cluster), names_from = ATAC_type, values_from = percent) %>% 
   datatable(.,rownames = FALSE,
  filter = 'top',       # add filter/search boxes
  options = list(
    pageLength = 10,
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    scrollX = TRUE)) %>% 
  DT::formatRound(columns = c("CAR", "DAR", "joint", "not_atac"), # explicitly name the numeric columns
    digits = 2)
  

prop_ATAC_df %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(cluster), names_from = ATAC_type, values_from = n) %>%
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(total=sum(c_across(any_of(c("CAR", "DAR","joint","not_atac"))))) %>% 
  datatable(.,rownames = FALSE,
  filter = 'top',       # add filter/search boxes
  options = list(
    pageLength = 10,
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    scrollX = TRUE), caption = "counts of H3K9me3 ROIs")
```

```{r}
Peakid_df <- data.frame(
  Peakid = H3K9me3_summit_gr_ext$Peakid,
  cluster = H3K9me3_summit_gr_ext$cluster
)

Peakid_df$is_CAR <-Peakid_df$Peakid %in% H3K9me3_ext_CAR_peakid$ROI_ID
Peakid_df$is_DAR <-Peakid_df$Peakid %in% H3K9me3_ext_DAR_peakid$ROI_ID
```


```{r testing set2vset1 car}
df_sub_set2v1 <- Peakid_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(cluster %in% c("Set_1", "Set_2"))
table(df_sub_set2v1$cluster, df_sub_set2v1$is_CAR)

fisher.test(table(df_sub_set2v1$cluster, df_sub_set2v1$is_CAR))


```
so SEt2 is enriched in CARs compared to SEt1

```{r}
df_sub_set3v1 <- Peakid_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(cluster %in% c("Set_1", "Set_2"))
table(df_sub_set3v1$cluster, df_sub_set3v1$is_CAR)

fisher.test(table(df_sub_set3v1$cluster, df_sub_set3v1$is_CAR))
```

Set 3 is also significantly enriched in CARs compared to SET 1

```{r}
DAR_sub_set2v1 <- Peakid_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(cluster %in% c("Set_1", "Set_2"))
table(DAR_sub_set2v1$cluster, DAR_sub_set2v1$is_DAR)

fisher.test(table(DAR_sub_set2v1$cluster, DAR_sub_set2v1$is_DAR))
```

SEt 2 significantly enriched in DARs compared to set 1

```{r}
DAR_sub_set3v1 <- Peakid_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(cluster %in% c("Set_1", "Set_3"))
table(DAR_sub_set3v1$cluster, DAR_sub_set3v1$is_DAR)

fisher.test(table(DAR_sub_set3v1$cluster, DAR_sub_set3v1$is_DAR))
```

Set 3 is significantly enriched in DARs vs Set 1
